evals.prompt: Create a draft PR for the current branch.
evals.expected_output: A draft pull request created on GitHub with a structured title and body containing decisions and trade-offs.
assertions: The agent runs scripts/prepare_pr.py to inspect repository state
The agent checks branch protection and switches to a feature branch if protected
The agent verifies remote synchronization before pushing
The agent extracts design decisions and trade-offs via the decision-analyst subagent
The agent formats a release-please compatible PR title
The agent creates or updates the pull request via gh pr create or gh pr edit
